operator.name: VideoFileReaderOp
operator.description: FFmpeg-backed decoder operator. Reads an .mp4 (or any libavformat-supported container, including RTSP/HTTP live streams) frame-by-frame on the CPU, uploads each decoded frame to device memory, and emits it as a holoscan::Tensor. Supported output layouts are NHWC and NCHW; supported pixel formats are rgb24/bgr24 (uint8), rgb_fp32/bgr_fp32 (float, normalized to [0, 1]), grayscale_u8, and grayscale_fp32. Resize and layout conversion are performed via libswscale.
